title: Neighbourhood success equals game value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game and let $\rho$ label each vertex by an alphabet coordinate. The average, first over a uniform vertex and then over a uniform neighbour of that vertex, of the indicator that the constraint permutation sends the neighbour's label to the vertex's label equals the value of the associated constraint satisfaction instance under $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: A labeling ρ of vertices by alphabet coordinates
